ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Lantern Deeps
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Ships the persistent underground "Lantern Deeps" cave-map dungeon layer (LANTERN_DEEPS_INJECTION_1, design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_lantern_deeps.md): a natural-emergence entrance building that appears on qualifying nightside/cold-biome maps and, when entered, generates a permanent pocket map using Biomes! Caverns' BMT_CrystalCaverns biome def. This mod depends on Biomes! Caverns for the biome def itself - it does not ship any cave biome, crystal formations, or cavern-shape logic of its own. Also ships RUT_LanternDeepEmergence (the natural-emergence entrance ThingDef) and the GenStep that scatters it onto qualifying host maps.
